strings.zh: 秀力博士失踪前不久,{NEWLINE}有一个阴沉脸的男人来到研究所,{CLEAR}说要买秀力博士的研究成果,{CLEAR}但是被博士拒绝了。{SCROLL}那个男人临走时曾放话说{NEWLINE}无论如何都要得到博士的研究成果,{CLEAR}接着没过几天博士就失踪了。{CLEAR}所以我觉得比起未知图腾,{CLEAR}博士的失踪与那个男人关系更大。
strings.en: Shortly before Professor Hale{NEWLINE}disappeared, a gloomy-faced{CLEAR}man came to the Research{CLEAR}Center and said he wanted to{CLEAR}buy the professor’s research.{CLEAR}The professor turned him down.{SCROLL}As he left, the man said he’d{NEWLINE}get the professor’s research no{CLEAR}matter what. A few days later,{CLEAR}the professor disappeared.{SCROLL}So I think that man has more{NEWLINE}to do with it than the Unown.
